art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Primera señal discreta que indica que comienzan las rutas de Velmora. Debe ser visible pero no monumental y respetar la cultura de orientación sutil.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide forest-edge travel scene focused on Marca de Nhal, the first subtle route indication associated with the paths toward Velmora. The sign must be understated and practical: a small deliberate arrangement or repeated tactile/reflective cue integrated into root, wood or stone near the path, easy to miss at a glance but recognizable up close. Open Lethra light is fading behind while Nhal canopy darkens ahead. Keep the exact symbol non-linguistic and simple, not a written sign.
negative_constraints: No readable writing, alphabet, runes or invented heraldry
No monumental marker, statue, gate or shrine
Do not turn the marker into a UI icon
No characters or creatures as focal subject
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/REGIONAL_CONNECTIONS.md — Ribera Sombría / Marca de Nhal
notes: Fiel al anclaje geográfico canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto ni mecánica.
